mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_object_deletion_queue ( object_key, attempts, delete_passes_remaining, next_attempt_at ) VALUES (#{objectKey}, 1, #{deletePassesRemaining}, #{nextAttemptAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE attempts = LEAST(user_object_deletion_queue.attempts + 1, 2147483647), next_attempt_at = IF( VALUES(delete_passes_remaining) > user_object_deletion_queue.delete_passes_remaining, GREATEST(user_object_deletion_queue.next_attempt_at, VALUES(next_attempt_at)), LEAST(user_object_deletion_queue.next_attempt_at, VALUES(next_attempt_at)) ), delete_passes_remaining = GREATEST( user_object_deletion_queue.delete_passes_remaining, VALUES(delete_passes_remaining) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_object_deletion_queue WHERE object_key LIKE CONCAT(#{objectKeyPrefix}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE user_object_deletion_queue SET attempts = LEAST(attempts + 1, 2147483647), delete_passes_remaining = delete_passes_remaining - 1, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_passes_remaining > 1
